drafts.question: Will the FAO Food Price Index for 2026-11, as first published, be above 133.9 (the 2026-10 value as published on the day this draft was written)?

baseline.basis: Share of the last 120 months in which the index rose from the month before, in today's revised series.

drafts.caveat: FAO revises earlier months; the comparison value can change before the release.
